source.citation: Dwivedi-Yu JA, Oppler ZJ, Mitchell MW, Song YS, Brisson D (2023) A fast machine-learning-guided primer design pipeline for selective whole genome amplification. PLOS Comput Biol 19(4): e1010137.
source.targets: pcDNA and pLTR plasmids - the same two shipped in examples/plasmid_example
source.measurement: qPCR fold amplification, mean of 2-3 replicates per plasmid
source.notes: Site counts recomputed with neoswga's own scanner (circular, both strands). Every primer has exactly 1 on-target and 0 off-target sites: they were selected that way, so site geometry is CONSTANT and this dataset cannot test site-ratio-based selectivity prediction. It does test whether sequence-level properties predict measured amplification.
